title: A whole meeting allows another choice

captions.physics: Bringing shared leisure into a whole

meaning: Shared experience can be complete and alive when expecting ideal fullness leaves room for freely mutual desire.
text: Wholeness can support a meeting until it becomes a requirement imposed on every impression. The World in the physical position of Svadhisthana allows a pleasant shared idea to be completed. The World in energy leans towards demanding flawless closure. The Lovers in emotions offer joy in freely mutual choice. These Worlds differ: the first gathers the occasion through actions, while the second requires definitive fullness from it. Both responses can remain warm even with a small unfinished detail.

For example, you finish a joint drawing evening with a shared picture. One thinks it still needs a neat background, while the other wants to sit beside you and look at the amusing figures. **A whole meeting leaves freedom to choose each other now.** You can recognise the picture as ready for tonight and decide together whether to return later. An imperfect detail does not cancel both people’s agreement. It can belong to a living memory of how you participated freely.

The difficulty is continuing for a correct ending while wanting company is postponed. The result gradually receives more attention than reciprocity. A small stop allows actual agreement to be heard, beyond readiness to help finish at any cost. One may name further drawing as a separate wish, preserving the other’s freedom to finish participating without indebtedness.
